what: Operator catalog and harness-validation evidence for the Q2 evaluator-mutation study (branch stage0/q2-mut-operators). No checker was run and the confirmatory mutation campaign has not started; it waits for the preregistration freeze.

files.operator-catalog.json: catalog() output: 64 operators with family, label class, target, check kinds, aspects, provenance, stratum, and a SHA-256 over the descriptions and operator sources (catalog_sha256).
files.validation-synthetic.json: End-to-end run of every operator on synthetic documents in the LO-VM image (job 431).
files.devsmoke-dev.json: Edit-primitive smoke run on 14 development-split OSWorld files (job 432); labels not reported.
files.prereg-operators-section.md: Operator items for the q2-0a preregistration; an input for the preregistration author, not frozen.
files.devplan-dev.json: Label rules exercised with the blind specs on the 14 dev tasks (no checker).

third_party_python_packages: none: the operators, the purity oracle and the appliers use the standard library, plus LibreOffice's own pyuno inside the container
release_policy: Recipes carry SHA-256 digests of the text they expect plus at most a few words of edited text; mutant documents and per-mutant records stay on the host.
